title: OutcomeRecord
description: A real-world outcome observed AFTER a verdict — the learning-loop moat seed (D15). Append-only, keyed by candidate_id, joinable to ANY judged candidate (especially KILLS, to detect false kills). Deliberately NOT part of the in-the-moment kill-pass verdict, which cannot know the future.

revenue.description: USD (monthly or total, per observer convention); null when failed/unknown

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the outcome was observed
